chapter: The 1940s: small groups, Teddy Wilson and Ethel Waters
title: Small-group dates and the Blues in the Night broadcast
summary: His own group played the Waldorf and a six-piece WOR broadcast tied to the Warner Brothers film Blues in the Night.
